licensePolicy: The corpus is research input for a private, derived aggregate model. Raw athlete records are never committed and never published. Only the aggregate model in src/model/generated.json ships.
note: World Athletics publishes an exact date of birth on calendar result rows, which is what makes an age-to-the-day fit possible at all. Age groups or birth years are not sufficient and are never approximated.

sources.name: World Athletics calendar competition results
sources.access: GraphQL calendar endpoint, requires WORLD_ATHLETICS_GRAPHQL_KEY in the environment
sources.dobPrecision: exact date of birth on most rows
sources.coverage: 2016-03 onward; 7,759 competitions enumerated, 157,145 flat-distance youth rows, 152 federations, DOB fill rate 44-100% by federation
knownGaps: The endpoint returns no road-race or cross-country results at all; every cross-country and marathon competition in the calendar comes back with zero events.
Some large meets publish only a subset of events through this endpoint, for example the Millrose Games returns three field events and no running events.
Race-level dates are frequently absent, so the competition start date is used; heats and finals are indistinguishable in the payload.
Hand timing is only flagged explicitly when it is electronic, so the corpus is effectively electronic-timing only.

sources.name: OpenTrack
sources.dobPrecision: age class only, no date of birth
sources.note: Hosts results for the Nordic federations including under-13 school and age-group meets. Publishes an Aldersklass column, never a date, so it cannot support an age-to-the-day fit at any age.

sources.name: ATHMIN (Austria OLV, German school athletics)
sources.dobPrecision: year of birth only (Jahrgang), including U10 and U12 classes
sources.note: Has the only under-13 competition records found, but a year of birth is a 365-day uncertainty. Folding it into a day-level curve would corrupt the product's central claim, so it is excluded and those ages fall back to the published benchmark instead.
